text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Matikanefukukitaru and a few
others
gather in a classroom around a
ouija board.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Spirits abound, hear my plea! 'Tis only
you who
can assist me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A precious lucky item has gone astray!
Please
show me a sign to lead the way!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Calm down, Fukukitaru. Look, we're also
here to
help, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Resorting to a ouija board to find a lost
item? I
guess that's the Fukukitaru we
know.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I suppose, but... she seems a lot more
panicky
today. Let's stick with her until
she's gotten it out
of her system.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now then! Be fair and true!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
O spirits, I declare! I beseech you—of
your
presence, let us be aware!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ten-yen coin begins to slowly move
as if in
response to Matikanefukukitaru's
pleas!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Eek?! It r-rolled out from underneath our
fingers!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A spirit has descended! Woiyaaaaa!
Haiyaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me where my precious item of
good
fortune lies!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ten-yen coin begins to slide again,
stopping
over three letters—"P," "O,"
and "T."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, yes, yes, YEEEEES! The spirit
has
spoken!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That spells "pot"! As in "cook or put
away the
pot"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now we're cooking! But we're gonna have to work for it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Uhhh... Is that how you use a ouija
board? Aren't
we supposed to wait for it
to completely spell out
the answer?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru seems... a lot more panicked
than I
thought.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All shall be solved if I follow your
guidance, O
wise spirit! What must I do?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They continue to use the ouija board,

Fukukitaru-style.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
E! As in... "endure exercise"?! Okay,
then! I'll do
thirty squats!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
R! "Run over to get a drink"! The perfect
reward
after my second set of thirty
squats! I'm sure we'll
find some kind of
hint if we do that!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
T! That must mean the "tree stump"! I'm
sure that
will lead the way to my
handkerchief!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAHHHHH! I can't find it
anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's about time we tell her that
she's doing
it wrong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...How about we look for your
handkerchief the
old-fashioned way?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
O spirit so great! My academy life
depends on my
lucky item!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I've—sniff!—made such amazing friends thanks to its blessings!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
As such, it's essential to me! Pleeeeease!
I'm
begging you, Great Spirit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was a lucky item to boost her fortune
in
friendship. Her friends feel conflicted
now having
learned the reason for
Matikanefukukitaru's state
of panic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that... item, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! You two look so serious! Is
something
wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's a long story, but helping you find
your
precious item is our priority.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Let's try searching the dorms and
cafeteria
again.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh! How amazing are these friends of
mine! I'm
blessed beyond belief!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Matikanefukukitaru gushes about
her
friends, she looks toward the sky. In
that
moment...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
OHHHH! THAT TREETOP! My
handkerchief is
stuck up there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? Really?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I have the glorious spirit to thank for
this! Many
thanks, many thanks, O spirit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What are you thanking the spirit for?

"P-O-T-E-E-R-T" doesn't mean anything.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But "P-O-T-E-E-R-T" backwards
is...
"treetop..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No way...
